name: of_P
statement: ∀ q n : ℕ, HigherFacesVanish q ((P q).f (n + 1) : X _⦋n + 1⦌ ⟶ X _⦋n + 1⦌) | 0 => fun n j hj₁ => by lia | q + 1 => fun n => by simp only [P_succ] exact (of_P q n).induction  set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in @[reassoc] theorem comp_P_eq_self {Y : C} {n q : ℕ} {φ : Y ⟶ X _⦋n + 1⦌} (v : HigherFacesVanish q φ) : φ ≫ (P q).f (n + 1) = φ
